EmailTemplate.subject: Public Disclosure – Submission Received – {!PublicComplaint.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Do not reply to this email. This is an automated notification, and this mailbox is not monitored.
Thank you for your submission through the Public Disclosure website.
Your reference number is: [Case ID]
This email confirms that we have received your submission. It does not mean that the information submitted has been reviewed, verified, accepted, or that any action has been taken.
Your submission will be reviewed by the appropriate Health Authority based on the information you provided.
If additional information is required, the Health Authority may contact you using the contact information provided with your submission. Not all submissions require a response.
Please keep your reference number for your records.
Thank you.
We acknowledge the territories of First Nations around B.C. and are grateful to carry out our work on these lands.
